messages.subject: actionButton in conditionalPanel
parts:
Is it allowed to have actionButton in conditionalPanel? If the actionButton in the conditionalPanel is clicked, why sometimes the action is triggered more than once?

I created a simple example:

ui.R:

library(shiny)

shinyUI(
    fluidPage
    (
        titlePanel("Hello"),
        sidebarLayout(
            sidebarPanel(
                checkboxInput("check", "Check"),

                conditionalPanel(
                    condition="input.check",
                    actionButton("Go", "Go")
                    )
                ),
            mainPanel(
                plotOutput("test")
                )
            )
       
        )
    )

server.R:
library(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output)
            {
                output$test <- renderPlot({
                    print(input$Go)
                    if(input$Go==0)
                        return()
                    hist(rnorm(1000))
                })
            }
            )


when I click the actionButton, sometimes the action is triggered once, sometimes twice. Where am I doing wrong? Thanks.
